pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + one regular chest. A Slime Chest is not the crafting ingredient.

Starts waiting; select Haul. It uses a fixed release-centered area and same-owner or mutually shared requests. It collects requested worker cargo, delivers to storage, and supplies tools or materials. It has no equipment slots.

Capacity is always twice a normal bag at the same stats: 18 slots, +6 per upgrade, up to 54 through normal training. A second bag page opens above 27 slots; use the arrows to change pages. $(l:cooperation/network)Warehouse storage$() has priority over Slime Chests.
